svg.title: fascicle: everything is a Step<i, o>
svg.desc: On the left, fascicle's keyless hello flow: the number 1 enters a sequence of two steps, add (n + 1) gives 2, double (n * 2) gives 4, and the sequence is itself a Step<number, number>. On the right, an agent drawn as a Step<task, result> holding a model call, a tool call, and a plain function, each a Step<i, o>, wired with primitives such as sequence, parallel, branch, retry, loop, and chain, and the whole is still a Step. On the line, fascicle sits underneath: storyboard, runciter, and penfield run on it.

svg.text: Everything is a Step<i, o>, from a one-line function to an agent with a dozen model calls inside.
